item.title: SCP-5739
item.content:encoded:
FIRST THING'S FIRST! There is a hidden message within the SCP-XXXX-1 instances and not everyone will find it on their first read. I'm disclosing it in the collapsable below, so consider this a warning if you'd like to go figure it out yourself.

Hidden Message
Hidden Message

The first letter of every line in an SCP-XXXX-1 instance spells out a phrase.

Okay, other things to note.

  • I drew the image and you can find more of my art here
  • Please leave a comment if you've got critique!

I think that's everything! Thank you for reading!

item.title: SCP-5819
item.content:encoded: An amulet that shrinks certain lifeforms and enlarges others would make a fine SCP in my opinion. But the tone is perhaps not as clinical as it could be, and the addenda read as if they're written by an Elizabethan street urchin instead of a Foundation employee. No vote for now, but I look forward to seeing how this SCP evolves.

item.title: SCP-5298
item.content:encoded: Regarding “Argus” - it’s a sort of step up from Cernunnos in terms of “we’re not even allowed to try and hide it, it’s in someone else’s jurisdiction now”

item.title: SCP-5148
item.content:encoded: Several problems — lacking clinical tone, feels derivative, and logistic problems — mercury is solid only below -39C, yet this containment requirement is only implied.

item.title: SCP-5133
item.content:encoded: Not a big fan of 'dangerous SCP just wandering around because we can't figure out Contain' and I don't think there's any good reason to not make it more-easily containable.
